title: An Optimal Control Approach To Transformer Training
summary: In this paper, we develop a rigorous optimal control-theoretic approach to Transformer training that respects key structural constraints such as (i) realized-input-independence during execution, (ii) the ensemble control nature of the problem, and (iii) positional dependence. We model the Transformer architecture as a discrete-time controlled particle system with shared actions, exhibiting noise-free controlled McKean--Vlasov dynamics, and we show that lifting the dynamics to probability measures produces a fully-observed Markov decision process (MDP).
